briefdescription.para: Native toolbox operation benchmarks for Phase 5 performance hardening.

sect2.title: Scope
sect2.para: Measures direct toolbox-native operations (extraction, text processing, fingerprinting) to establish release baselines and replace proxy-only benchmark mappings.

sect2.title: Threading Model
sect2.para: All benchmarks use steady_clock for deterministic latency measurement. Thread-safe operations verified via concurrent extraction scenarios.
